Finds the tops of the trees as the peaks of the geomorphons of a surface model.

**Toolbox folder:** Lesto › vegetation<br>
**Status:** Experimental<br>
**Keywords:** raster, maxima, geomorphon<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello, Silvia Franceschi<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.GeomorphonMaximaFinder`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inDTM` | raster file |  |  | The elevation model of the ground, on the grid of the surface model. |
| `inDSM` | raster file |  |  | The surface model, as the highest points of each cell. |
| `pRadius` | double | m | `0` | The search radius of the geomorphons: about the size of the crowns to recognize. |
| `pThreshold` | double | degree | `1.0` | The flatness angle of the geomorphons: the terrain within it from the line of sight is level. |
| `pElevDiffThres` | double | m | `1.0` | The largest difference of the heights over the ground in the 3 x 3 cells around a top: steeper tops are discarded. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outMaxima` | output file |  | The tops, with an id and their height over the ground (elev). |

**References**

- Jasiewicz, J., Stepinski, T. F. (2013). Geomorphons - a pattern recognition approach to classification and mapping of landforms. Geomorphology, 182, 147-156.
